title: Use VideoML visuals and voiceover independently of Babulus
description:
## Behavior
VideoML authors can use visual effects alone or standard voiceover with open Auritus-backed local synthesis, without a Babulus account.

## Acceptance
Given a visual-only composition, when previewed or exported, no voice model/provider is required.
Given a narrated composition and a supported installed Auritus model, when generated locally, speech and timing require no paid provider or hosted rendering service.
Babulus-specific orchestration is optional; standard voiceover belongs in VideoML.

## Implementation handoff
Do not dispatch this broad story directly. Dispatch the bounded Terra packets under this milestone: videoml-207e97, videoml-684f74, videoml-d42794, videoml-fa90b2. Binding contracts/defaults and review gates are in initiative videoml-dbc2b1 D01–D15. Story closure requires all relevant packet evidence and primary review.
